CustomField.description: Beacon Data Universe Tier (1-4) from Key Job Title and the related Account. 1: key job title and Account Active Drug Count 4+. 2: key job title and Segment Top 200, Emerging, Mid Market or Other Pharma. 3: key job title and Segment Contract Org. 4: key job title and Segment Other. Blank when no tier criteria are met (including no key job title or no Account). Tier 5 (campaign activity) not yet implemented. Custom field created specifically for the HubSpot integration, outside of the HubSpot managed package.
CustomField.formula: IF( NOT( Key_Job_Title__c ), NULL, IF( BLANKVALUE( Account__r.Active_Drug_Count__c, 0 ) >= 4, 1, CASE( Account__r.Segment__c, "Top 200 Pharma", 2, "Emerging Pharma", 2, "Mid Market Pharma", 2, "Other Pharma", 2, "Contract Org", 3, "Other", 4, NULL )))
CustomField.label: Data Universe Tier
